briefing.headline: OpenAI and DeepSeek escalate multi-agent race as US-China compute restrictions tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration on reasoning agents while governments accelerate export controls. Funding remains robust with major rounds closing in infrastructure and safety tooling.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced multi-agent orchestration. DeepSeek-V4 matches o3 performance at lower inference cost. Anthropic and xAI both shipped incremental updates this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia announced Blackwell Ultra ramp with TSMC. Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new 100k H100-equivalent clusters in Texas and Nevada.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the next 12 months see a single lab achieve reliable autonomous scientific discovery before regulatory brakes engage?
